title: How a Godly Man Reaches Out to a Brother Who Went Quiet
caption:
A godly man texts the brother who went quiet.

Don't wait for a crisis. Send the small message tonight, skip the lecture, then show up in person. Proverbs 27:17 only works when you're in the same room.

Who just popped into your head? Text him before you scroll.

#faith #godlymen #christianman #brotherhood #friendship #community
